text: The monthly rent shall be paid by the tenant on or before the fifth day of each month.
label: Rent

text: The tenant agrees to pay Rs. 25,000 as monthly rent for the premises.
label: Rent

text: The tenant shall pay a refundable security deposit of Rs. 75,000 at the beginning of the tenancy.
label: Deposit

text: The security deposit will be returned within thirty days after vacant possession is handed over.
label: Deposit

text: The landlord shall be responsible for structural repairs and major maintenance of the property.
label: Maintenance

text: The tenant shall keep the premises clean and shall pay for damage caused by the tenant.
label: Maintenance

text: A late payment fee of Rs. 500 shall apply for each month in which rent remains unpaid.
label: Penalty

text: The tenant shall pay a penalty for any delay in handing over the premises after termination.
label: Penalty

text: The tenant shall pay electricity, water, and gas charges according to the utility bills.
label: Utilities

text: All utility charges consumed by the tenant shall be paid by the tenant each month.
label: Utilities

text: Either party may terminate this agreement by giving sixty days written notice.
label: Termination

text: On termination, the tenant shall vacate and return the keys to the landlord.
label: Termination
